# Aligned With Heaven Inc.

> Christian equipment nonprofit supporting outreach and spiritual warfare tools. Books, the "Golfing With The King" spiritual caddy, teaching resources and outbound store links.

- Home: https://ittybittybites.github.io/

- Give: https://ittybittybites.github.io/give/

- Press & News: https://ittybittybites.github.io/press/

## Books

- [The Reality of Death: Are You Ready?](https://ittybittybites.github.io/books/the-reality-of-death-are-you-ready/): A practical and spiritual guide to facing life's final chapter with peace, purpose, and unshakable hope in Christ. By Dr. Earle S. Gregory.
- [365 Days to Becoming a Supernatural Teacher](https://ittybittybites.github.io/books/365-days-to-becoming-a-supernatural-teacher/): A year-long devotional for teachers of all grade levels, drawing on Christian insight and decades of educational experience — designed to bring peace into the classroom.

## Store

- [TEXTING WITH THE KING — Phone Size](https://ittybittybites.github.io/store/texting-with-the-king-phone-size/): Evangelize while you are on your phone. Place the sticker below the logo on the back of your phone and sow seeds into the audience of those around you who will read it.
- [TEXTING WITH THE KING — Computer Size](https://ittybittybites.github.io/store/texting-with-the-king-computer-size/): Evangelize while you're on your computer. Place the sticker on the cover of your Apple computer or device right below the logo — a witness that needs no words.
- [365 Days To Becoming A Supernatural Teacher](https://ittybittybites.github.io/store/365-days-to-becoming-a-supernatural-teacher/): Written by a former teacher and administrator, this year-long devotional helps teachers fight the good fight with the presence of God in the classroom.

## Blog

- [What to Think About the Results of the 2026 Elections?](https://ittybittybites.github.io/blog/what-to-think-about-the-results-of-the-2026-elections/): Many have weighed in on the results of the 2026 elections. A reflection on what voters may have been repudiating — and where real hope for the nation lies.
